intent.summary: Retail-channel air quality detector for rental apartments. Lowest possible unit cost is the top priority: target CNY 12 per housing at 10k units/year. Plain but tidy look in a colour that hides scuffs and fingerprints. It must survive knocks on a desk. Two-part shell, no decoration beyond a printed logo, budget tooling.

conflicts.description: Target housing cost of CNY 12 may be difficult to achieve with ABS or rABS at 10k units/year, especially with budget tooling and a two-part shell. Material and processing costs could exceed the target.
conflicts.proposed_resolution: Consider using a single-part shell or reducing wall thickness; explore lower-cost material grades or negotiate with suppliers; if not feasible, increase target cost to CNY 15-18.

intent.summary: Sustainable edition for an eco-conscious brand. Use only recycled ABS for every plastic part, no paint or coatings, a mono-material housing and screw-free disassembly so it can be repaired and recycled. Honest, warm, slightly speckled look; carbon footprint matters more than gloss.
must_haves: Use only recycled ABS for every plastic part

conflicts.description: Screw-free disassembly may conflict with achieving a secure, durable housing that can withstand typical handling and potential drops, especially with recycled ABS which may have slightly lower mechanical properties.
conflicts.proposed_resolution: Use snap-fit or clip features designed for repeated disassembly, and validate through drop testing and lifecycle testing.

conflicts.description: Recycled ABS may have higher per-unit cost or limited availability compared to virgin ABS, potentially conflicting with the BOM ceiling of CNY 18/unit.
conflicts.proposed_resolution: Source rABS from reliable suppliers and optimize part design to minimize material usage; consider cost trade-offs with brand sustainability goals.

intent.summary: Flagship portable air-quality detector housing with premium soft-touch painted finish, IP67 waterproof, ultra-slim 18 mm profile, 100% recycled plastic, under 120 g, and housing cost ≤ CNY 9, launching in six weeks.

conflicts.description: IP67 waterproofing typically requires thicker walls, gaskets, and sealing features, making an 18 mm ultra-slim profile extremely difficult to achieve while maintaining structural integrity and sealing.
conflicts.proposed_resolution: Relax thickness to at least 22-25 mm or reduce waterproof rating to IP54.

conflicts.description: Achieving a housing cost of ≤ CNY 9 with premium soft-touch painted finish, IP67 sealing, and 100% recycled plastic is likely infeasible at 10,000 units/year due to material, painting, and sealing costs.
conflicts.proposed_resolution: Increase cost target to at least CNY 15-18 or reduce finish/waterproof requirements.

conflicts.description: 100% recycled ABS (rABS) may have lower mechanical properties and consistency, making it challenging to achieve IP67 sealing and ultra-slim walls without defects.
conflicts.proposed_resolution: Use a blend with virgin material or accept higher wall thickness.

conflicts.description: Total product mass under 120 g with internals weighing ~92 g leaves only 28 g for housing, which is extremely low for an IP67 sealed enclosure with soft-touch paint and necessary wall thickness.
conflicts.proposed_resolution: Increase mass limit to at least 140 g or reduce waterproof rating.

conflicts.description: Launch in six weeks is very aggressive for tooling, testing (especially IP67), painting process development, and production ramp-up.
conflicts.proposed_resolution: Extend timeline to at least 12-16 weeks or simplify requirements.
